{'translation': 'ChatGPT Atlas（OpenAI 專為 Mac 推出的網頁瀏覽器）即將走到生命盡頭。OpenAI 已分享 ChatGPT Atlas 於本週末停止運作後的相關細節。', 'source': 'ChatGPT Atlas（OpenAI 專為 Mac 推出的網頁瀏覽器）即將走到生命盡頭。OpenAI 已分享 ChatGPT Atlas 於本週末停止運作後的相關細節。'}

{'translation': 'ChatGPT 將取代 ChatGPT Atlas', 'source': 'ChatGPT will replace ChatGPT Atlas'}

{'translation': '正如我們 7 月的報導，OpenAI 正放棄旗下獨立的 Atlas 瀏覽器，改為專注於內建於新版 ChatGPT 桌面應用程式中的瀏覽器工具。經過短暫的過渡期後，Atlas 將於 8 月 9 日停止運作。', 'source': 'As we reported in July, OpenAI is dropping its standalone Atlas browser in favor of focusing on browser tools built into the new version of its ChatGPT desktop app. After a brief transition period, Atlas will stop functioning on August 9.'}

{'translation': 'OpenAI 警告，Atlas 在該日期之後可能無法再開啟、瀏覽或支援代理式工作流程。由於停產的瀏覽器將不再獲得安全更新，用戶應盡快轉用其他受支援的替代方案。', 'source': 'OpenAI warns that Atlas may no longer be able to open, browse, or support agentic workflows after that date. Since the discontinued browser will no longer receive security updates, users should switch to another supported alternative as soon as possible.'}

{'translation': '對部分用戶而言，是次過渡可能需要一些手動處理。Atlas 的書籤不會自動轉移。OpenAI 建議用戶在週日死線前將書�匯出為 HTML 檔案，並儲存重要的網頁。', 'source': 'For some users, the transition may require some manual handling. Atlas bookmarks will not transfer automatically. OpenAI recommends users export their bookmarks as HTML files before the Sunday deadline and save important web pages.'}

{'translation': 'Cookies 在可行的情況下或有匯出選項。ChatGPT 的對話記錄則獨立儲存，將會繼續保留。', 'source': 'There may be an export option for cookies where feasible. ChatGPT conversation history is stored separately and will be retained.'}

{'translation': 'AI 瀏覽器替代方案', 'source': 'AI Browser Alternatives'}

{'translation': 'OpenAI 正引導用戶轉用新版的 ChatGPT 桌面應用程式。其內建瀏覽器支援多重分頁、下載、網站登入、自動填寫、密碼管理、擴充功能，以及持續保存的瀏覽器狀態。然而，這並非以瀏覽器為先的使用體驗。', 'source': 'OpenAI is directing users to switch to the new version of the ChatGPT desktop app. Its built-in browser supports multiple tabs, downloads, website logins, autofill, password management, extensions, and persistently saved browser state. However, this is not a browser-first experience.'}

{'translation': '若任務需要使用現有的 Chrome 個人檔案、已登入的工作階段、開啟中的分頁或其他擴充功能，該公司建議使用其 Chrome 擴充功能。ChatGPT 的桌面應用程式亦內含「computer use」功能，在獲授權的情況下可選擇性控制 Safari。', 'source': 'If tasks require using an existing Chrome profile, logged-in sessions, open tabs, or other extensions, the company recommends using its Chrome extension. The ChatGPT desktop app also includes a “computer use” feature that can optionally control Safari with authorization.'}

{'translation': 'Mac 上還有許多其他 AI 瀏覽器選擇，包括 Comet、Dia、Opera Neon 和 Aside。Anthropic 亦採取類似的雙軌策略：Claude Code 提供沙盒化的應用程式內瀏覽器，而其 Chrome 擴充功能則可配合現有的已登入工作階段使用。', 'source': 'There are many other AI browser options on the Mac, including Comet, Dia, Opera Neon, and Aside. Anthropic is also taking a similar dual-track approach: Claude Code provides a sandboxed in-app browser, while its Chrome extension works with existing logged-in sessions.'}

{'translation': '盡情發揮你 Apple 產品的最大功效', 'source': 'Get the most out of your Apple products'}
